marie.docs: Quick FYI: I'm opening a small PR to harmonize our function/tool-calling + structured-output docs. The aim is to ship two canonical examples (invoice + user_intent), add a compact schema-pointer envelope for small clients, and include a short consumer-test example for CI. Will open in ~30m.

dev-elliot: Sounds good. For the compact envelope do you want us to use `schema_ref` pointing at /docs/schemas or inline minimal schemas? I prefer schema_ref to keep pages light.

marie.docs: Going with `schema_ref`. Plan: move canonical JSON to /docs/schemas/{invoice,user_intent}.json, show both full-inline and compact `schema_ref` variants, add guardrails about fallback order (validate -> partial parse -> raw text), and sweep two broken anchors in parsing patterns.

samir.eng: I'll run the parser harness on the example prompts and paste raw outputs so the samples match actual runtime normalization (notably: floats lose trailing .0 and single-item arrays can be collapsed unless `minItems:1`).

tess-qa: Please include a tiny CLI consumer test in the PR that we can run in docs CI. Example command to add to the PR description: `make docs-lint && ./tools/parse_validator --schema docs/schemas/invoice.json --prompts examples/invoice_prompts.txt`. I'll run it once the PR is up.

marie.docs: Good call. Also adding a "gotchas" subsection about `oneOf` ambiguity and nullable arrays; show an explicit fallback snippet for partial parses.

dev-elliot: I'll update TS + Python SDK snippets to the new `structured_output` invocation shape. Compact example I'll use in the snippets:
```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "fetch_invoice", "arguments": {"id": "INV-2026"}}, "structured_output": {"schema_ref": "/docs/schemas/invoice.json"}}
```

samir.eng: When I run the harness I'll paste an "observed vs expected" short list if anything diverges so reviewers can see why outputs look different.

marie.docs: Also adding a 1-line streaming note: annotate partial tool-call chunks with `chunk_index` and `final_chunk: true` for reassembly. Keeping a compact example for mobile and a full example for readers who want everything inline.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5237 by marie.docs

marie.docs: Assigning reviewers: @dev-elliot, @samir.eng, @tess-qa. Target merge: next Tue EOD if CI/lint pass. Will ping when first commit lands.
